videos.script: Lesson 33 wrapped errors with the percent-w verb, adding context at every layer. This lesson takes them apart again. {{chain}} A wrapped error is not one long string. It is a chain of values, each one holding the next. errors.Unwrap takes one link off, and a short loop prints every link, down to the answer the operating system gave. {{is}} Then the question a caller really asks. Is there a missing file somewhere in here? Comparing with double equals says no, because the outside of the chain is a wrapper. errors.Is walks the chain and says yes. One percent-v in the wrong place, and it says no again. {{as}} Last, getting data back out. errors.As finds the link of the type you name and hands it to you, fields and all: the operation, the path and the cause. Give it the wrong kind of target and the program panics, though go vet warns you first. By the end you can wrap an error at every layer, and the code above can still find what it needs.
